description.value: Boston Pizza is a well-established Canadian casual dining chain and sports bar with a long history rooted in BC, first franchised in Penticton in 1968. The Chilliwack location on Luckakuck Way offers a full dine-in restaurant experience alongside takeout and delivery, with an extensive menu spanning pizza, pasta, wings, burgers, and more. A touring cyclist stopping here will find a familiar, reliable sit-down meal option with broad menu variety in a suburban commercial area of Chilliwack.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at bostonpizza.com/en/locations/chilliwack.html confirms the Chilliwack location at 45305 Luckakuck Way with phone (604) 858-3333, matching OSM tags exactly. The website confirms takeout/delivery ordering and explicitly states 'Vegan and Glutenwise® options also available' with a dedicated GlutenWise® menu section. No evidence of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill is present in the website content; these are marked null per absence-of-evidence rules. OSM opening hours (Mo-Su 12:00-21:00) conflict with website hours (11 AM–midnight/1 AM), flagged as a concern.
